1.

Come, let us in the Spirit now raise with joy A song to our Lord and our God in honour, And praise highly His love of immeasurable height, That all who hear us may learn, How Jesus has loved us, yea, unto the death of the cross, And in His grace saved us from sin and the distress of the abyss, And for us opened the gates of salvation!

2.

Thou art our light, O Christ, our strength is in Thee; Though poor, in Thee we are rich. Thou art our own Lord, and Thine we are, O salvation, O joy without compare! Yea, none, none is found in all the earth’s expanse, Who loves us so faithfully and loves every moment As Thou, Son of God, who for us suffered death.

3.

Yea, let us then sing with delight and joyful sound, Encouraging and strengthening one another To praise and extol our Lord and our God, Who through the wilderness has promised to walk with us, And faithfully to guide us with the clear light of the Word, Until with joy we enter into our Father’s house, To be at home there with Him eternally!
